data.one_liner: Provides the hook protocol specification for bundling native code with Dart packages.
data.what_it_does: This package provides the API for code assets to be used with package:hooks. It is used in build and link hooks to inform the Dart and Flutter SDKs about code assets that need to be bundled with an application.
use_when: You need to bundle native code (C, C++, Objective-C, Rust, Go) with your Dart or Flutter package.
You are writing a build or link hook for native asset compilation.
avoid_when: You are building a pure Dart application without native C/C++ or other compiled binary dependencies.
You do not use package:hooks for native asset building.
strengths: Standardized protocol for native code bundling in Dart and Flutter.
Supports custom operating systems, architectures, and sanitizers.
weaknesses: Breaking changes can occur with custom target representations in maps and sets (e.g., v2.0.0 update).
Requires understanding native build hooks and toolchains.
data.setup_notes: Requires setting up build and link hooks in the hook/ directory of your package.
